The girl voice (Moana, now Ciela) rendered a bare 'Chur!' as 'Sure' in 23 of 33 experimental takes across 12 tag/punctuation/context variants (the rest were mostly fragments like Ch-r or Choo choo), so the manifest line was changed to 'Good as gold!' (Ace keeps 'Chur!')
regenerated best of 4, still 'Yeah' - accepted as a wordless jump exertion sound
none needed: 'Wheee' vs 'Wee' is a spelling difference (scorer now treats wh~w)

ciela_rename.renamed: 66 girl lines moana_* -> ciela_* (files renamed, audio unchanged; their STT results carried over)
ciela_rename.name_check: verify_voice_stt.mjs cuts the name out of each line that says Ciela and reads it 3x with Scribe forced to Mandarin (one character per syllable). Pass = 谢啦/谢拉 (xie la, /ɕjɛ la/) in >= 2 of 3 reads, or an English transcript of exactly 'Ciela'/'Cielo'. Details in scripts/voices.json -> ciela.pronunciation.
